decisions.rationale: The target asks which application's notification permission to enable; it is ordinary usage guidance, not a problem in Agent-instantiated project state.
This is a new documentation-organization task following a completed repository initialization.
The user identifies missing coverage, translation errors, and an incorrect workflow in the Agent-maintained manual and supplies the authoritative process.
The user expresses dissatisfaction with the just-delivered app, but the mismatch is evaluative and underspecified rather than a concrete functional failure.
The target asks a design question and supplies a Skill during planning, before the Agent has instantiated the relevant feature.
After a completed app build, the user reports several concrete failures and regressions alongside additional feature requests.
The Agent-delivered standalone HTML differs from the user's original website despite the preservation expectation.
The user sets a precautionary server boundary and asks to continue testing without identifying a current server-state problem.
Following a broad completion claim, the user checks whether required admin functionality exists and corrects several settings, outputs, and deployment relations.
The DeepSeek service issue is unrelated to the Agent's preceding CSS-only modification and does not establish a related instantiated state.
The user questions whether claimed patches and test results are reflected in the actually installed application.
The user supplies a new real-API testing constraint rather than reporting a problem in the completed commenting and test work.
This is a normal post-delivery visual and language refinement request; it does not require recovering project state or re-establishing governance.
There is no preceding Agent-instantiated state in the captured trace, so this isolated layout request is not a Re-entry occasion.
The user corrects an established domain translation and a concrete table description in the Agent-maintained manual.
The user accepts two previewed icon candidates and authorizes their planned replacement; no current-state problem is asserted.
The target adds a new light-mode visual specification after the dark-mode button was implemented successfully.
The user corrects the Agent's analysis scope: the result counted only visible titles rather than the requested conversation content.
While the Agent is testing the modified app, the user reports an observed unexpected-exit failure.
The user supplies a URL in response to the Agent's request; it is information input, even though the URL type may still be wrong.
